requirements.reason: The provider-independent WS04-01C boundary must remain distinct from final infrastructure, provider, deployment, and production role proof owned by WS04-01D.
The future database evidence contract must preserve sanitized EN-03 metadata, provenance, open gaps, and evidence hygiene without committing raw provider material.
The connection-budget formula and consumer inventory must be deterministic, complete, and unable to hide unknown consumers as zero.
Future final budget values must carry the full evidence-based limits basis, telemetry boundary, boundary tests, and safe adjustment or rollback requirements.
The final topology contract must require provider capacity, direct/pooler/proxy mode, runtime process topology, autoscaling, rolling overlap, and startup/shutdown compatibility evidence.
The future role/grant contract must require application, migration, support, reporting, backup, human, and owner-role verification with least-privilege checks.
WS04-01C must preserve accepted A/B behavior and must not add production source, migrations, provider settings, deployment configuration, credentials, or real production database state.
WS04-01D must remain mandatory before final closeout and C must not mark final provider topology, connection budget, headroom, or production roles/grants as proved.
